rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Floribunda.
Exhibition name: White Arrow
rows.Origin:
Bred by Kikuo Teranishi (Japan, 2004).
Introduced in Japan by Itami Rose Nursery in 2005 as 'White Arrow'.
rows.Bloom: Cream. Mild fragrance. Medium, double (17-25 petals), cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
